**1. 봉밀가 강남구청점, 청류 본점**
- 여름 입문용으로 소개된 곳입니다. 봉밀가 강남구청점은 9년 연속 미쉐린 가이드가 선택한 메밀면으로 소개되었고, 청류 본점은 1++ 한우를 오랜 시간 끓여 낸 깊은 육향의 보양식 평양냉면으로 언급되었습니다. (출처: 에스콰이어 코리아, 2026.05.30)

**2. 우래옥 (종로)**
- 서울 시내의 최고의 평양냉면 집이라는 평을 받은 곳으로 여러 기사에 등장합니다. 빅뱅 태양의 최애 맛집으로도 꼽혔고, 입문자에게 진한 육향을 느낄 수 있는 곳으로 소개되었습니다. (출처: 에스콰이어 코리아, 2026.08.24)

**3. 진미평양냉면 (논현)**
- 20년 냉면 장인의 노하우가 담긴 곳으로, 냉면과 함께 먹는 불고기가 더 유명한 곳이라고 합니다. 가격은 냉면 15,000원, 어복쟁반 소 60,000원으로 안내되어 있습니다. 다만 이 가격은 기사 작성 시점 기준이므로 방문 전 확인이 필요합니다.

**4. 서령 (회현/남대문)**
- 평양냉면 마니아들의 성지로 소개되었습니다. 평양냉면 정석의 맛을 보여주는 순면이 가장 인기 메뉴이며, 매장이 넓고 쾌적해 모임 장소로도 좋다고 합니다.

**5. 김인복의 광평 (삼성동)**
- 코엑스의 최고 맛집으로 꼽히며 인기가 높아 웨이팅이 많은 편입니다. 평양냉면과 함께 골동면도 추천되었습니다.

**6. 기타 언급된 곳**
- 경평면옥: 오이와 메밀 향이 돋보이는 깔끔한 맛으로 소개되었습니다.
- 의정부 평양면옥: 육수가 매력적이라 밥을 말아 먹는 사람도 많다고 합니다.
- 서평면옥: 우래옥과 평양면옥 사이의 맛이라는 평가를 받았습니다.

**참고**
- 입문자에게는 우래옥, 서령, 경평면옥처럼 담백하고 무난한 곳이 좋고, 진한 육향을 원하면 청류나 의정부 평양면옥이 맞을 수 있습니다.
- 인기 식당은 웨이팅이 길 수 있으니 방문 전 확인하세요.

Based on the search, these Seoul restaurants serve Pyongyang-style or similar cold noodles and carry a Michelin Bib Gourmand designation. I could not confirm the 2026 status of each one against Michelin's own listings, so check the official Michelin Guide site before you go.

**Seoul options**

- **Woo Lae Oak (우래옥):** This is the most established option. It dates back to the 1940s and is now a heritage name for Pyeongyang-style naengmyeon and classic bulgogi in Seoul. The naengmyeon comes in a chilled beef broth that is clean and subtle rather than spicy, with buckwheat noodles that are firm but bouncy. The same listing says MICHELIN notes the historical roots and the way the restaurant maintains North Korean–style recipes from the founder's home region.

- **Nampo Myeonok (남포면옥), Euljiro:** A reviewer describes it as a legendary spot for Pyongyang Naengmyeon (North Korean-style cold noodles). It is tucked away in the vibrant Euljiro neighborhood. The same review says all the beef used in their noodle dishes is premium Hanwoo (Korean beef). The Bib Gourmand history is inconsistent across sources. One review says earning a Michelin Bib Gourmand every year since 2018, while another says it has been consistently awarded a Michelin Bib Gourmand for nearly a decade. Both point to a long run, but neither is an official Michelin source.

- **Andeok (안덕):** This is a 2026 Bib Gourmand rookie. It is anchored by a mild, beef-based naengguksu reminiscent of Pyongyang-style naengmyeon, and the restaurant is another buckwheat-rich noodle restaurant. This is the newest addition on the list, so it has the least track record.

- **Seokyonanmyunbang (석요냉면방):** One listing gives its Michelin status as Bib Gourmand / Selected, and the description is that it is part of the new wave of noodle-focused eateries. The "Selected" label suggests it may not hold a Bib Gourmand, so verify this one specifically.

**Not in Seoul**

- **100.1.Pyeongnaeng (100.1.평냉), Busan:** This is a Pyongyang-style naengmyeon spot that earned a Michelin Bib Gourmand in both 2024 and 2025. It is outside your Seoul search, but it is worth knowing about if your trip includes Busan.

**Caveat:** The 2026 Seoul & Busan Bib Gourmand announcement covered 51 restaurants in Seoul and 20 in Busan, with eight new additions. Andeok is one of those new additions. Woo Lae Oak and Nampo Myeonok appear in the search results as current Bib Gourmand listings, but I did not find a direct 2026 Michelin page confirming each one.

- **Sobakeeri Suzu:** a new entry led by a Japan-trained chef, using Korean-grown buckwheat for its soba.

**Context:** One source reports that Michelin recognizes 71 Bib Gourmand restaurants across South Korea, including 51 in Seoul for 2026. content.text:
I couldn't find one authoritative ranking of Seoul's Pyongyang naengmyeon restaurants. Michelin, Korean magazines and review sites each list different places. These are the three that are most consistently recommended and have the strongest sources as of October 2026:

### 1. Woo Lae Oak (우래옥), Euljiro 4-ga, Jung-gu
- **Rating:** Michelin Bib Gourmand. This is listed on Michelin's own guide page, which is the strongest source here.
- **What to expect:** Open since 1946. The broth is Korean beef (hanwoo) foreshank simmered for hours and seasoned with only salt and soy sauce. Esquire Korea called it one of the best Pyongyang naengmyeon restaurants in Seoul in 2026, and it's a good first choice if you want a strong beef flavour. The bulgogi grilled at the table is also well known.
- **Sources:** [Michelin Guide – Woo Lae Oak](https://guide.michelin.com/kr/en/seoul-capital-area/seoul/restaurant/woo-lae-oak); [Esquire Korea, Aug 2026](https://www.esquirekorea.co.kr/article/1908417)

### 2. Nampo Myeonok (남포면옥), Euljiro, Jung-gu
- **Rating:** Reported as a Michelin Bib Gourmand every year since 2018. That claim comes from a review site, though, and I couldn't confirm the 2026 listing on Michelin's own site.
- **What to expect:** A long-running Pyongyang naengmyeon restaurant tucked away in Euljiro. It uses premium Korean beef in its noodle dishes.
- **Source:** [Trvlogue – Nampo Myeonok Review 2026](https://www.trvlogue.com/en/nampo-myeonok-seoul-review)
